_comment: The org's one shortcode map (pandoscope/pandoscope#61): shortcode to repository under repos, in the format the thread ledger reads, e.g. "MR": "my-org/my-repo". An order's name uses the lowercase form, as in review-spec-fidelity-opus-mr4-1. Seeded once and owned by this waybill: the template ships no org's names and never overwrites the org's entries.
